[EN] (This book appears to be the Centurion's journal. It contains stories about an evil cult that's behind the gulas and about how the cultists brought {@LinkCreature:9#1400#Azarel's juggernaut} and {@LinkCreature:9#1410#labyrinthine stalkers} here. One particular entry stands out. It says these monsters can be defeated by pulling out their teeth.)
[ES] (Este libro parece ser el diario del centurión. Contiene historias sobre un culto malvado que está detrás de los gulas y sobre cómo los cultistas trajeron a {@LinkCreature:9#1400#Azarel's juggernaut} y {@LinkCreature:9#1410#labyrinthine stalkers} aquí. Una entrada en particular destaca. Dice que estos monstruos pueden ser derrotados arrancándoles los dientes.)

[EN] , you're amazing! I once received a report about the maze monster, but I wasn't sure if we could even get through its protectors.

Obviously the monster shows the level of threat we're facing, and our risk has doubled since the cultists are in cooperation with the gulas.
[ES] ¡, eres increíble! Una vez recibí un informe sobre el monstruo del laberinto, pero no estaba seguro de si podríamos siquiera superar a sus protectores.

Obviamente, el monstruo muestra el nivel de amenaza al que nos enfrentamos, y nuestro riesgo se ha duplicado desde que los cultistas cooperan con los gulas.

[EN] Did you really defeat those giant monsters?
[ES] ¿De verdad derrotaste a esos monstruos gigantes?
